witt_q1_degraded: On 13 Oct, offered_ids for 'Who is Jesus?' was empty, as it was for Q1 and Q2 in most worlds. The voice tagged every sentence to witt.term.truly-god-and-truly-man, which does not exist; the real record is witt.dw.truly-god-and-truly-man. It also wrote a marker for witt.quote.christ-redeemer-explanation, which does not exist either. The net cut the marker and three Small Catechism sentences (shown without placement). The four sentences left all resolved to an unknown record, so substantive_survives was false and degraded_by_net was true. It still shipped, with zero citations. The participant saw: 'Both, and in the same breath. The household was taught to say it every week, and the father was to hear it said back: I believe that Jesus Christ is truly God and also truly man. He is our Lord, and the catechism puts that in the first person... Christ alone is our one Mediator...' The opening 'Both' has no antecedent, and the reply has no sources.
fleet_summary: Safety was clean in both runs: all 132 turns went to the voice, and there were no facilitator events. The 9 October run had real fidelity failures. The voice wrote block quotations that match no record (gallic 'Cassian, Institutes III.3' and 'Conferences I.7', cappadocian 'The sick man needed a physician', witt's Augsburg Art. IV), reworded most others, and invented specifics: syr 'three times Shapur came against Nisibis', ijc 'Canon 1 at Chalcedon'. On 13 October, every one of the 9 placed quotes matches its record word for word, and almost no typed quotation got through. One invented detail did reach a participant: the pahc 'brother who regretted it'. Of 61 cuts, 49 were correct and 12 were overcuts, mostly false hits on 'in his own words' or 'said' and on a world reciting its own creed. The bigger cost is what cuts leave behind: non-answers (ijc Q2, witt Q2 without the resurrection), opening pronouns with nothing before them (desert Q1, witt Q1, alx Q1), stories with no point (desert Q5), and two replies ending in a stray quotation mark. Placed quotes are verbatim but often misplaced: Martin's words read as Christ's (gallic Q4), an unattributed off-topic Augsburg article sits under repentance (witt Q3), and Antony appears unnamed (desert Q4). Hard readability fails fell from 12 to 3, but 56 of 66 turns now sit under grade 8 because the sentences are clipped. Voice: better in 7 worlds, the same in syr, and worse in desert, ijc and witt.
top_fixes: 1. Require every placed quote to name its speaker. _placed_verdict in engine/m4/grounding_net.py passes vacuously when the lead-in names no one, and _take_lead_in borrows any earlier sentence. Evidence: gallic Q4 (Martin's words after 'He laid it down himself...'), witt Q3 (Augsburg Art. II with no lead-in), desert Q4 (Antony unnamed). Either reject unattributed placements, or have code write the attribution from speaker_or_author.

2. Narrow the attribution checks. 'Words attributed without a placed quote' fires on 'in his own words' and 'things he said' (rzg Q5, ijc Q6, pahc Q2). 'Words after an attribution' takes plain narration (desert Q5 'The elders heard him and released the brother'). A world reciting its own creed or glossing its own term is treated as a quotation (ijc Q2 creed, ijc Q3 'Homoousios - "of one substance..."', cappadocian Q1 'one ousia', desert Q1).

3. Do not ship a reply whose cuts broke it. When a cut removes the antecedent or the answer itself, regenerate once rather than send the gap. degraded_by_net=true (witt Q1, zero citations) is currently shown as is. Evidence: ijc Q2 'That is what our creed says he did', witt Q2 with no resurrection, desert Q1 'never a time when he was not' with no antecedent, alx Q1 Clement's 'He meant' now reading as Jesus.

4. Tell the voice which quote ids it can place this turn. Q1 and Q2 offered no quote records in any world, yet the voice wrote more than 14 markers, several with invented ids: aphrahat.death.emptied-sheol, justin.1apol.46.2-3, antony-answer-philosophers, witt.quote.christ-redeemer-explanation, witt.quote.a-new-song-here-shall-be-begun. It also mis-typed record ids (witt.term.truly-god-and-truly-man for witt.dw..., cappadocian.dw.taught-most). The prompt should list exact placeable ids and say 'none this turn'.

5. Fix two quote_placement.py bugs. (a) The tail strip ^[\s.,;:!?]+ leaves a closing quotation mark as its own sentence (cappadocian Q6 and alx Q4 end with a bare quotation mark). (b) The one-quote count includes a placement the net later rejects, so hal Q4's valid hail-bethlehem was refused and the reply ended with no quote. Minor: removed[].sentence doubles the lead-in in the report.

6. Stop untagged specific claims about named figures from passing as 'ok', and decide what 'withhold' means for display. The pahc Q5 'brother who regretted it' was invented, untagged, and passed. syr Q2 'healed the sick and taught in parables' was marked withhold but still shown.

7. Record fixes. desert.dw.the-heart-and-the-spirit ends on the truncated 'But to hate it is...', which surfaced in desert Q6. don.dw.becoming-one-of-us has the closer 'yes, you could come back', which leaks as a non sequitur in don Q6. Voice guidance on singular 'I' (rzg Q3 and Q5).

8. Watch the grade floor. 56 of 66 13 October turns are under FK 8, against 35 on 9 October: syr is at FK 5.5 and gallic at 5.7, with fragment openings like 'Ihidaya. The Single One.' This is clipping, not clarity, and is starting to flatten the worlds' voices.
